title: Short-Sale Payoff Statement — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction
content:
## Short-sale payoff statement — Payoff and Loan Satisfaction

A short-sale statement is the statement on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, issued to that borrower. Issuing it moves the case from opened to terms issued and fixes the short-sale statement balance.

**Who may receive terms.** Terms are issued only to a requester the plan's statement recipients allow: the borrower, a confirmed successor in interest (a customer whose profile is that of a successor in interest linked to the borrower) where the plan requires successor confirmation, or a title company or new lender holding the borrower's written authorization where the plan accepts third-party authorization, and in addition to the borrower of record on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record; any other request is declined as not authorized.

**Statement balance of each kind of statement.** Every statement other than a retention statement and a short-sale statement keeps its statement balance as the balance on the statement date plus the per diem for each day from the statement date to the good-through date; a short-sale statement, the statement on the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, carries the short-sale statement balance as its statement balance.

**When the balance is fixed.** The short-sale statement balance is fixed only after the payoff case carries a recorded per diem for the statement date. While the case shows no recorded per diem for that date, it has no short-sale statement balance.

### Issuing the short-sale statement

**Capability.** The tool issues the payoff statement on a borrower's short-sale payoff case, moving the case from `opened` to `terms_issued`. The statement is dated today. The case records the statement date, the good-through date and the statement balance passed in. The daily accrual, required payoff amount, contract price, allowed closing costs, appraised value basis and funds held are left unchanged; the statement request and maturity case named are quoted back.

**How it is invoked.** `issue_sale_payoff_statement_764045f1` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `payoff_case_id` | the payoff case the statement is issued on, as returned by the payoff case lookup | identifier |
| `payoff_request_id` | the payoff statement request on file that this write answers, as returned by the payoff submission lookup | identifier |
| `maturity_case_id` | the loan's maturity case, as returned by the maturity case lookup | identifier |
| `statement_good_through_date` | the last calendar day the statement's figures are good | YYYY-MM-DD in the servicer's local calendar |
| `statement_balance` | the loan balance projected to the good-through date | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation naming the payoff case, statement request and maturity case reference numbers, the status `terms_issued`, the statement date and good-through date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the statement balance (USD, 2 decimal places); the status `terms_issued` shows the statement was issued. No other return or error is defined for this tool.
